headline: Gemini-Page-Insights: Claude Code skill for
short_description: Say goodbye to endless scrolling through lengthy articles! **Gemini Page Insights** harnesses the power of Google's cutting-edge Gemini AI to deliver instant, intelligent summaries of any webpage - right in your browser.
author: xPOURY4

sections.overview:
Gemini Page Insights is an automation skill that uses Google's Gemini AI to generate intelligent summaries of webpages directly in your browser. Rather than reading through long articles, users can quickly access key information with instant AI-powered summaries. The skill integrates Gemini's advanced language capabilities to extract and condense webpage content efficiently.
Quickly summarize news articles and blog posts without reading full text
Extract key information from lengthy documentation and research papers
Get instant summaries of product pages and reviews while shopping online
Condense technical articles and tutorials for faster comprehension
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/xPOURY4/Gemini-Page-Insights`
sections.usage:
```
Summarize the content of this webpage [URL] in 3 bullet points. Highlight the main ideas, key data points, and any notable conclusions. Focus on insights relevant to [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector.
```
Copy

```
# Webpage Summary

- **Key Insight**: The article discusses the growing trend of AI adoption in the [INDUSTRY] sector, with a particular focus on [COMPANY]'s recent advancements.
- **Data Point**: A study cited in the article shows that 65% of [INDUSTRY] companies plan to increase their AI investment by 2025.
- **Conclusion**: The author concludes that companies like [COMPANY] are well-positioned to lead the AI revolution in [INDUSTRY] due to their innovative approach and strategic partnerships.
```
